ideal: Every file and folder as small and plain as the job allows: green checks, short units, no escapes, no dead or copied code, true docs.

sources.title: Alex Russell: The Performance Inequality Gap, 2026

quality: No function past 60 lines or file past 400, no type escape, nothing unused or copied, docs commented, short and never drifting.
speed: The web loop answers in about a minute, the Mac jobs in two, and any answer reads in a minute.
consumption: Few tokens to read each file, and the lane inside five minutes.
